x: John Knifton after the loss of Middleton, became our leading scorer and he finished a very determined 3rd only 39 secs. behind the winner. The next man home for us was Ray Hall in 6th position and Barnes and L.-Jones completed the foursome by crossing the line almost together.

The team,consisting of "Yo Yo" Hall (he goes downhill alright but can't climb 'em) Ray Hall,the chaffeur; Gerry Cameron, the 2nd fastest Scot; and Steve Laker Jones, at present tail end Charlie, were helped out this time by Harry Shields.
In a top class field Jack Buckner outsprinted Steve Jones and National winner Dave Lewis at the end of an accurately measured but twisting course.

Paul begun 1990 with an impressive 2nd place in the New Year's Day Morpeth to Newcastle road race, just behind Paul Cuskin, but claiming the scalps of Steve Jones, Steve Brace and Geoff Wightman amongst others.

Some well known names featured among the vanquished - Dave Long, Steve Jones, Hugh Jones - and his time placed him at 6th on the all-time British list for the distance and fastest in the world for 1991 so far.
Sporting a serious new haircut, a 'Steve Jones' as he later described it, Owain Lewes was our silver medallist, and Team Manager Don Anderson put in some good work for 3rd.

His winning time of 60:09 took 50 seconds off Steve Jones' British mark set in 1986 and no other Briton has gone below 61:00. It also moved him to fourth fastest of all time behind Tanui (59:47), Masya (60:02) and Moneghetti (60:06).
